description: This file defines a Dagger module that provides a CoroutineScope initialized with a SupervisorJob and a default dispatcher. It uses annotations for dependency injection, including a custom qualifier for application scope, and is part of the network dependency injection setup for the application.

classes.name: ApplicationScope
classes.description: A qualifier annotation used to specify the application-wide CoroutineScope provided by this module.

classes.name: CoroutineScopesModule
classes.description: A Dagger module that provides a singleton CoroutineScope configured with a SupervisorJob and a default dispatcher.

methods.name: providesCoroutineScope
methods.description: Provides a singleton CoroutineScope using a SupervisorJob and the default dispatcher injected into it.
